sections.principal_risks: Principal risks and uncertainties The process of risk acceptance and risk management is addressed through a framework of policies , procedures and internal controls. All policies are subject to Board approval and ongoing review by management. Compliance with regulation , legal and ethical standards is a high priority for the company. The main risk to the company remains its reliance on suppliers based outside the UK.This means that the exchange rate and any new tariff arrangements imposed by the EU could have a serious impact on the growth of the business. The directors are taking steps to mitigate this risk through internal hedging policies and maintaining healthy margins capable of withstanding fluctuations in price.UK economic growth remains unclear and future prospects may be influenced by developments outside of the UK. Key performance indicators The results for the company and its subsidiary for the year were considered to be satisfactory by the directors.Turnover has increased 1.26% in the year , the directors consider this to be a satisfactory result. Revenue is anticipated to show steady growth for financial year 2026. Other performance indicators The directors consider turnover , gross profit margin (GPM) and cash flow to be the primary KPI's. Turnover increased in the year by 1.26%. GPM has fallen slightly during the year to 6.24% , this is due to competitive pricing in the industry. Building positive relationships with stakeholders that share our values is important to us, and working together towards shared goals assists us in delivering long-term sustainable success. Customers Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We work with customers to get a meaningful understanding of their requirements, connecting their business and commercial ambitions. W e believe in cultivating and providing the right brand for customers today, tomorrow and as long as required until target expectations materialize. W e’re dedicated to helping customers . We endeavour to help our customers reach their full potential – To Launch, Evolve and Sustain . Suppliers We build strong relationships with our suppliers to develop mutually beneficial and lasting partnerships. Engagement with suppliers is primarily through a series of interactions and formal reviews and we also host regular conferences to bring suppliers and customers together to discuss shared goals and build relationships. Key areas of focus include innovation, product development, health and safety and sustainability.
